Puff Pastry Cones
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 4:07pm

Ingredients




2 cups flour
1 stick butter
1 stick butter
1 egg yolk
3/4 cup sour cream
Sugar
cinnamon, combined
Preserves: Raspberry, Nuts

Preparation

1 Mix as pastry by cutting with two knives. Shape into three balls. Chill. Roll out and cut into 8 triangles. Fill as desired. Roll up starting at wide outer edge. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top. Place on cookie sheets and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
